plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: This app uses your location to record where a note or GPS sample was captured, only when you tap "Capture location".

plugins.microphonePermission: This app uses your microphone to record a voice note, only when you tap "Record voice note".

plugins.photosPermission: This app opens your photo library only when you tap "Choose photo" on an Explore prompt, so you can share a picture of a place.
plugins.cameraPermission: This app uses your camera only when you tap "Take photo" on an Explore prompt, so you can share how a place looks right now.
